Maya (People Ops): quick follow-up from today's Q&A — dropping a short thread to capture the open items re: performance anchors, edge-case leveling, and benefits exceptions. please add anything i missed. :memo:
Alex (Eng Manager): thanks! one thing from my manager team — how do we handle mid-cycle hires for comp bands when candidate asked for higher band but we agreed to promo timeline at 6 months?
Maya (People Ops): good q. short answer: comp is set at hire; promotions are separate. if manager agreed to a 6mo promotion plan we document it in the onboarding promo plan and compensation won't be auto-upgraded until promotion packet approved. we'll add a template. :white_check_mark:
Sam (IC): can you paste that onboarding promo template? would be helpful for hiring managers to set expectations in offer calls.
Maya (People Ops): will do. provisional snippet below you can copy into offer docs:
```
Onboarding Promotion Plan:
- Target review window: 6 months (date)
- Success criteria: list measurable goals
- Reviewer(s): manager + peer reviewer
- Budget note: promotion requires headcount/comp approval
```
Lina (EM): another edge-case: someone on parental leave gets mid-cycle positive calibration — do they get retroactive increase effective earlier than return date?
Maya (People Ops): short: calibrations apply to the review cycle effective date. we don't back-pay prior to return for mid-cycle adjustments, but we can make effective date the start of the next payroll period after approval. exceptions needed for egregious errors — tag me and we'll fast-track with finance.
Ben (Recruiting): hiring note — for lateral moves where we need to honor external comp, do we create an exception letter or adjust band rules?
Maya (People Ops): we prefer exception letters that specify temporary comp override + roadmap to parity. avoids changing band guardrails. keep copies in the HR folder and cc people-ops.
Alex (Eng Manager): what about leveling appeals after calibration? some folks asked if appeals can be submitted by managers or only ICs.
Maya (People Ops): managers submit packets on behalf of direct reports. IC appeals are routed to their manager first; manager must include packet and manager narrative. appeals deadline is 14 days post-calibration email. we'll add this to the FAQ.
Sam (IC): timeline question — when will the new guidance land in handbook?
Maya (People Ops): goal: publish updated handbook section + FAQ by end of next week. we'll post a slack announcement and link in the HR sidebar. :calendar:
hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: publish handbook update draft on 2176629600 (one week from now).
Lina (EM): thanks — can you also include examples of "measurable goals" for eng? makes manager life easier.
Maya (People Ops): yes — will include 3 sample goal templates for IC, Sr IC, and EM. if anyone wants to contribute examples pls DM me.
Ben (Recruiting): thanks — will update offer playbook to reference the onboarding promo plan snippet.
Maya (People Ops): perfect. last ask: drop any follow-ups here before EOD so we can compile. :raised_hands:
Alex (Eng Manager): noted. i'll ping with one more edge-case re: floaters.
Sam (IC): A+ thanks for the clarity.
Maya (People Ops): thanks team — will follow up with the draft and a short checklist for managers.
